info.desc: Actually is the third album, the second of entirely new music, by the UK electronic music group Pet Shop Boys. It was first released on September 7, 1987. This album is also the group's second-highest selling album of all time with over 4 million copies sold. Actually spawned four UK Top 10 singles: the number one lead-off single "It's a Sin," "Rent," "What Have I Done to Deserve This?," a duet with fellow Parlophone artist Dusty Springfield which peaked at #2 in both the UK and US and led to a major resurgence of interest in Springfield's earlier work; and .

podcast.body: This album, which produced the hit "It's a Sin," was reissued in the early 2000s. In the liner notes for this reissue, Neil Tennant famously described the duo's career at the time, stating, "I felt at this time that we had the secret of contemporary pop music that we knew what was required. We entered our imperial phase." "In those actually liner notes, Tennant said quote, I felt at this time that we had the secret of contemporary pop music that we knew what was required. We entered our imperial phase. Unquote."
